description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling visualization slices and chart data routes in a Superset frontend testing context, including intercepting network requests and managing chart aliases.

methods.name: isLegacyChart
methods.description: Determines if a visualization type is considered legacy based on predefined plugin list.

methods.name: isLegacyResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response object is from a legacy chart response.

methods.name: getSliceIdFromRequestUrl
methods.description: Extracts the slice ID from a given request URL.

methods.name: getChartDataRouteForSlice
methods.description: Returns the API route for fetching chart data based on whether the chart is legacy or modern.

methods.name: getChartAlias
methods.description: Creates a Cypress alias for a chart slice and sets up request interception.

methods.name: getChartAliases
methods.description: Generates Cypress aliases for multiple chart slices.

methods.name: interceptChart
methods.description: Sets up network request interception for chart data, supporting legacy and modern endpoints.
